definitions.explanation: A large, expensive, and impressive private residence. Emphasizes grandeur and luxury rather than mere size.

examples.japanese: {丘|おか}の{上|うえ}に{豪邸|ごうてい}が{建|た}っている。
examples.english: A mansion stands on top of the hill.

examples.japanese: {有名|ゆうめい}な{俳優|はいゆう}が{豪邸|ごうてい}を{購入|こうにゅう}したらしい。
examples.english: Apparently a famous actor bought a mansion.

examples.japanese: プールつきの{豪邸|ごうてい}に{住|す}むのが{子供|こども}の{頃|ころ}からの{夢|ゆめ}だった。
examples.english: Living in a mansion with a pool has been my dream since I was a child.

notes:
USAGE:
Always implies wealth and luxury. Often appears in celebrity gossip, real estate features, and lifestyle media. Unlike {大|おお}きい{家|いえ} which simply describes size, {豪邸|ごうてい} conveys impressiveness and opulence.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {豪邸|ごうてい}を{構|かま}える (to set up a grand residence)
- {豪邸|ごうてい}{暮|ぐ}らし (life in a mansion)
- {億|おく}ション{並|な}みの{豪邸|ごうてい} (a mansion rivaling a luxury condo)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {邸宅|ていたく}: stately residence — formal, slightly more neutral; used in real estate and legal contexts
- {屋敷|やしき}: estate — often implies a large property with grounds, can be old or traditional
